name: agentmesh
description: Shared collaboration infrastructure for AI coding agents and developers

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @agentmesh/protocol && npm run build -w @agentmesh/sdk
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @agentmesh/server && npm run build -w @agentmesh/cli && npm run build -w @agentmesh/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @agentmesh/server" "npm run dev -w @agentmesh/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @agentmesh/server
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test -w @agentmesh/protocol && npm run test -w @agentmesh/sdk && npm run test -w @agentmesh/cli && npm run test -w @agentmesh/web && npm run test -w @agentmesh/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
